Birth.BornCity: A village in the lands of the Arverni

Naked: Prefers to go barefoot whenever possible to better feel the earth.
Story: The five sisters are survivors of a Roman massacre in their Gallic village. Having lost their family and people, they fled into the forests. They have sworn a vow of celibacy, promising not to rest or know peace until Julius Caesar, the man responsible for their people's suffering, is dead. They use their unique combat skills to survive and fight back against the Roman invaders.

Details.Name: Shape

Details.Name: Musculature

Details.Name: Skin

Details.Name: Shape

Details.Name: Soles

Details.Name: Significance
Descriptions: A physical embodiment of her sworn vow of celibacy; a part of her body and future she has sacrificed for her singular purpose of vengeance.

Details.Name: Detail

Notes: As the eldest, she feels the weight of her sisters' survival and their vow on her shoulders.
